title: Gate flow `Flow save history and restore` failed when the run id completed a not_contains token
service: echopoint prod CI org flow suite (echopoint gate tag)
summary: The routine's third tag soak failed `Flow save history and restore` (af928132): node `get-restored` asserted the body does not contain `hist-c`, and the flow's own name `ep-hist-{{$runId}}` rendered as `ep-hist-ce16…`. Any run id starting with `c` failed it: one run in sixteen, in the echopoint gate tag since 2026-11-20T06:08Z. The routine replaced the body checks with JSONPath checks on the node display name, renamed the flow prefix, and added `audit_runid_collision.py` to every suite run; it found no other flow in the class.

impact.text: No customer impact. One soak failed. Each gate run had a 1 in 16 chance to fail and hold a prod deploy.

numbers.label: in the gate tag before the fix

trigger: Run id `ce16d4bb…` made the flow name contain `hist-c`.
detection: The routine's third soak at 18:52 UTC printed `FAILED … body not_contains expected=hist-c` and the routine read the full body.
resolution: Flow updated at 19:06 UTC (JSONPath on `display_name`, prefix `ep-history-`), green 3x; audit wired into run_suites.sh.

events.label: Routine adds the flow to the echopoint tag
events.detail: Generator `gen_flow_history.py`, 3 serial greens and 2 tag soaks.

events.label: Run id ce16… makes the name contain hist-c
Flow updated: JSONPath checks, ep-history- prefix
Green 3x; audit finds no other flow

whys.problem: A gate-tag flow failed with no product change

because.text: `get-restored` asserted the body does not contain `hist-c`, and the body held `ep-hist-ce16…`
The flow name carries `{{$runId}}` (hex), and the token's tail `c` is a hex digit
Absence was asserted on the whole body instead of on the field that holds the marker
No rule or check stops a body `not_contains` token that a per-run id in the same flow can complete
Three serial greens and two soaks did not show it: 15 of 16 run ids pass
The author's checks for a new flow were runs only: 3 serial greens and 2 tag soaks, no static review of assertions
Probabilistic false failures need a static check; repeated runs only sample them

well: The runner printed the actual body, so the cause was clear in one read.
wrong: A check written to prove the restored state was weaker than the JSONPath check beside it.
lucky: It failed in a soak, not in a gate holding a prod deploy.

actions.what: Assert on `display_name` by JSONPath; prefix `ep-history-` (flow af928132, generator)
`audit_runid_collision.py` runs on every tagged flow in run_suites.sh and prints RUNID-COLLISION
flow-suite-testing skill: assert absence on the field, not a body token

messaging.internal: Flow save history and restore could fail 1 run in 16 (run id completed a not_contains token); fixed and audited.
